titre: Utilisation des capacités sidérurgiques aux États-Unis
sous_titre: Taux hebdomadaire d'utilisation des capacités, en pourcentage, 2026

2 mai 2026.texte: The capability utilization rate stood at 80.4 percent, compared with 75.4 percent a year earlier when output was 1,694,000 net tons.

6 juin 2026.texte: Domestic facilities generated 1.877 million net tons of raw steel, achieving a capacity utilization rate of 81.3%.

1er août 2026.texte: American mills generated 1.87 million net tons of raw steel, with the capability utilization rate at 81.0%.

12 septembre 2026.texte: US domestic raw steel production was 1.900 million net tons while the capacity utilization rate was 82.3 percent.
